mask_rule: Use saved Stage02.2 held complete cycles; all valid accel/gyro samples in these time intervals withheld, including initialization gyro. Preserve GNSS row masks. Same phase-domain boundary exclusion for every model; no target cycle removed.
coefficient_prior: zero-mean Gaussian; position sin/cos sigma=0.05/h^2 m in NED; right-tangent rotation sigma=0.05/h rad. At 4Hz this permits ~31.6m/s2 and ~1.26rad/s per coefficient. No independent sensor nuisance basis.
initialization: Same Stage02 GNSS-training interpolation and EKF attitude for both; gyro initialization uses only new training-cycle mask; coefficients zero except fixed restart diagnostic. EKF attitude may indirectly expose held IMU; conditional development validation.
order: Synthetic gate, A short H0/H3, A full H0/H1/H3, B full H0/H1/H3, five A H3 sensitivities only if base finite and usable; no unbounded retries or searches
jacobian_gate: new composition/coefficients 1e-5 normalized; GP endpoint chain 5e-3 with small-angle limitation measured, not concealed
kinematics_gate: independent derivative refinement and off-grid integration; monitor inherited GP small-angle approximation rather than promise exact SO3 derivatives
identifiability: measure harmonic loading of slow/periodic terms; fixed coefficient restart; deterministic 0.8/1.2 coefficient exchange with inverse-composed slow knot states, no reoptimization
scope: rigid main-IMU installation point, not COM truth; no free periodic sensor nuisance, no labels/training/Stage03
